result.title: Self-Representation Alignment in Diffusion Models for Video Background Music Generation
result.summary: Diffusion models have been widely used for various generative tasks. However, recent studies have demonstrated that the internal representations learned in the diffusion models' denoising process are insufficiently meaningful, which can hinder the generation performance. To address this, we propose a novel diffusion U-Net architecture enhanced by explicitly aligning the weaker representation from the earlier layer conditioned on higher noise with the better representation from the later layer conditioned on lower noise during training, which we use for the challenging multimodal task of video background music generation. Our diffusion U-Net Self-Representation Alignment (U-SRA) employs an alignment loss to effectively guide our diffusion model to learn good internal representations, thereby enabling it to produce higher-quality symbolic music conditioned on video features. We employ a cross-attention mechanism to synchronize music with video segments. Experiments on a benchmark video-music dataset demonstrate that the proposed U-SRA approach for video background music generation surpasses the state-of-the-art across key evaluation metrics, including video-music alignment and overall music quality.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 U-SRA：在扩散 U-Net 训练中用对齐损失，把高噪声条件下较早层的较弱内部表示对齐到低噪声条件下较后层的较优表示，以改善表示质量，并将其用于视频背景音乐生成，配合交叉注意力同步音乐与视频片段。
AI.relevance_reason: 其以训练期对齐损失约束并改善内部表示（跨层、跨噪声条件）的机制，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的监督方式与贡献分配提供可核查的方法线索；但任务本身为跨模态音乐生成，与 VLM 推理的关联需进一步确认。
